final_assessment: 20 of 21 tasks done. task 1.4 measured once: all 50 --help pages (root, every command and subcommand) and orbit --version byte-identical before and after the builder refactor, and the production hooks still fire; task 2.1 measured markdown-it 15.0.2 (it ships its own types, so @types/markdown-it, written for 14, was not added): its fence tokens reach the four list-nested bash fences (continue, ff, propose, verify) and re-parsing the 11 markdown fences reaches the prompt template's inner bash fence; exit (1) figures: the sweep parsed 129 orbit snippets and set aside 35 bare command names, zero parse failures, zero guard failures, no further defect beyond the three escaped-backtick slips (architect.ts:50, review.ts:427 and :510), fixed with the architect pins and PASTE_ITEMS_BEFORE_RUNNERS moved and recorded; the sweep test holds a non-vacuity floor of 100, not a pin, so a body edit adding a snippet does not break it; task 4.1 ran red with 17 parity failures (nine missing commands, seven missing flags, config profile's positional) and none in the registry-only direction; filling the registry exposed a latent upstream zsh generator bug (an apostrophe is escaped as \' inside single quotes, so the script fails zsh -n), avoided by apostrophe-free registry descriptions and now caught by a zsh/bash -n check in the completion test, the generator itself untouched; 71 new tests (3066 → 3137); charter and exits revised under R-crc-12's first case; 6.4 is the user-validation handoff observed on this stage's system blind pair
